note: Ottawa NF two-loop campground among towering red pines beside Norway Lake, 8 mi SE of Sidnaw (Sidnaw Road south 5.5 mi, then 2 mi east on FR 2400), Kenton Ranger District. Sites are naturally screened by vegetation, each with a tent pad, table, fire ring and lantern post. A boat landing, change house and picnic area are adjacent. --Claude
summary: FS page (updated 2026-05-05): $22 single (confirmed), first-come only (confirmed; no recreation.gov listing), 14-day limit (new), season May 22 - October 15 (new; opens the Friday before Memorial Day), 27 drive-in sites for tents, trailers and motor homes (confirmed), vault toilets (confirmed), hand-pump drinking water (new), Senior/Access passes accepted. Run by Camp Host, LLC under the Kenton RD. Access via Sidnaw Road and FR 2400; the only Ottawa road alert near Kenton was the October 9-10, 2026 rally closure, now past. Note trimmed of field restatements.
